data.one_liner: Encode and decode EMVCO QR codes in Dart
data.what_it_does: This package provides classes to build, parse, and verify EMVCO QR payloads. It supports both MPM and CPM formats and includes CRC validation.
use_when: You need to generate an EMVQR for a merchant or payment terminal
You need to decode an EMVQR received from a customer
You need to verify the integrity of an EMVQR string
avoid_when: You only need to display or scan generic QR codes
You require a UI widget for QR code rendering
strengths: Supports both MPM and CPM EMV formats
weaknesses: No UI components for rendering QR codes
data.setup_notes: Add dependency in pubspec, no additional permissions or build steps
